sense: to keep something in your mind

pins.definition: To keep something in your mind or bring a past fact or event back to mind.
To have or bring back a memory of someone or something from the past.
To have someone or something in your memory; not to forget.

situation: An elderly woman sits in an armchair with an old photo album open on her lap, smiling softly as she looks at a photograph of herself as a young bride, her fingertip resting on the picture. A ribbon tied around her finger and a framed wedding portrait on the table behind her suggest the memory. The warm window light is soft and natural, and the scene is painted with calm realism.
subject: remembering the past, looking at an old photo

prompt: An elderly woman sits in an armchair with an old photo album open on her lap, smiling softly as she looks at a photograph of herself as a young bride, her fingertip resting on the picture. A ribbon tied around her finger and a framed wedding portrait on the table behind her suggest the memory. The warm window light is soft and natural, and the scene is painted with calm realism. surrealism in the manner of Magritte and Dalí, one impossible juxtaposition rendered with complete photographic conviction, still air, an empty horizon. One square illustration. The scene is fully rendered and fully inhabited — no silhouettes, no flat icons, no diagram, no empty schematic space. A single subject dominates the frame and everything else is arranged around it. Absolutely no text anywhere in the image: no letters, words, numbers, captions, labels, signage, logos, watermarks or pseudo-text.
